title: WoW but 2d
author: thoughtiwasgod
selftext:
AI: Originalyl started with 6.1 Sol but switched to Opus 5.5  
  
Using PixelFX and some effects from SpriteFusion

Sounds from WoW

comments.author: dreamer_2142
comments.body: Nice looking game, how does the MP work? is it p2p or you hosting a server on vps?

replies.author: thoughtiwasgod
replies.body:
thank you, it's currently server-authoritative multiplayer using HTTP polling.The backend runs on Node.js with SQLite for session persistence.

I'm still working on optimizing the multiplayer. Movement and ability inputs are responsive now, but some of the animations still stutter on the other player's screen. I'll try to put out a demo as soon as I can fix that.

replies.author: dreamer_2142
replies.body: Couldn't you use Epic online service? Better for the long run.

replies.author: thoughtiwasgod
replies.body: Looked it up and I dont think so because my game is entirely browser based.
